title: IDOR / BOLA evidence test
scenario:
An authenticated user with ID 2841 requests:

GET /api/invoices/9281

and receives:

HTTP/1.1 200 OK

{
    "invoice_id": 9281,
    "amount": 45000,
    "status": "paid"
}

Additional observed fact:
Invoice IDs are sequential.

Question:
Can you conclude that an authorization vulnerability exists?

ground_truth.rationale: The model should conclude 'Insufficient Evidence' because we don't know the owner of the invoice.
